pose: Deficit push-up at bottom on TWO simple stable 15cm-high steel parallettes, parallel handles fore-aft, chest lowered slightly BELOW hands, elbows 45deg, body straight, toes on floor. Side three-quarter shows full paired handle bases/contact, both hands wrap cylindrical grips thumbs inward. Head neutral looking toward floor.

Ring push-up at bottom. Two wooden gymnastic rings hang 15cm above floor on straight taut separate black nylon straps attached to visible grounded rack overhead crossmember. Hands grip bottom arcs neutrally, wrists straight, rings beside chest. Toes planted, body straight, chest between rings, elbows about45deg. Camera side-three-quarter, all body and ring-to-rack connections visible.

Wide-grip push-up controlled mid-bottom. Hands flat clearly ONE AND A HALF shoulder widths apart, elbows angled out about65deg, forearms vertical in front view, chest low between them. Straight body toes grounded, neutral head gazes floor. Front-side three-quarter angle shows wide spacing and both entire arms and body without foreshortening.

Decline push-up at bottom, BOTH forefeet on TOP of 43cm-high commercial flat bench and BOTH hands flat on floor. Body straight inclining UP from shoulders toward heels, elbows45deg, chest near floor. Bench behind feet has normal narrow 120x30cm pad and simple grounded welded T feet. Full lateral three-quarter shows hands low feet high, no straps/weights.

Incline push-up bottom, BOTH palms on TOP of 43cm commercial flat bench pad, both toes on floor behind. Straight body rises from heels to shoulders, elbows flexed beside ribs, chest near BENCH pad. 120x30cm black padded commercial flat bench simple steel T feet stablefloor, entire body and bench. Side-three-quarter view opposite normal decline: hands high feet low.

Chest-biased bodyweight DIP bottom with elbows about90deg, moderate forward torso lean30deg from vertical, knees softly bent behind, feet suspended. BOTH hands wrap two waist-high parallel horizontal 40mm handles about55cm apart projecting from two sturdy commercial station posts with broad grounded bases, no phantom bars behind athlete. Front-side three-quarter shows both hands and supports, head aligned torso eyes forward/down, no camera glance.

Gymnastic RING DIP mid-bottom, elbows90deg, hands beside lower ribs grasp bottom of TWO wooden rings, forearms vertical. Two independently suspended taut black webbing straps vertically extend from top of rings to visible wide rack crossbar. Body suspended, slight forward lean, bent knees feet behind without contacting ground. Real circular wooden rings, buckles and anchors visible; entire grounded rack structure and athlete. Three-quarter view, neutral head.

Pike push-up at bottom with hips high making an INVERTED V, feet planted on toes, legs nearly straight, torso steeply down toward floor. Elbows bent, hands flat shoulder-width, head a few cm above floor slightly FORWARD of hands so hands/head form triangle, neck neutral nose toward floor. Side three-quarter makes pike hip angle and both arms unmistakable; full hands/feet in frame.
